description: This file defines the HarTracer class responsible for capturing and exporting HTTP Archive (HAR) data during browser or network request activities within the Playwright testing framework. It manages request/response events, creates HAR entries, and handles content embedding or attachment, with options for filtering and data omission.

classes.name: HarTracer
classes.description: Class responsible for tracing network requests and responses to generate HAR logs, with support for content embedding, filtering, and event handling.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes event listeners and begins HAR tracing based on provided options.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops tracing, removes event listeners, and compiles the HAR log.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Waits for all ongoing request/response processing to complete.
